audiences.jobToBeDone: Determine whether TCCG is a fit for a construction, modernization, HVAC, BIM/VDC, project-controls or owner-reporting need without assuming unverified qualification or availability.
Evaluate TCCG for opportunity-specific teaming, BIM/VDC, HVAC, project-controls or specialty delivery support.
Review TCCG's controlled capture and qualification process before relying on registrations, licenses, bonding, certifications or past-performance claims.

offers.description: A structured review of scope, location, schedule, procurement method, delivery requirements and documentary qualification gates before TCCG represents fit or availability.
A qualification package assembled from current verified identifiers, licenses, insurance, bonding, certifications and relevant past-performance evidence when available for the specific opportunity.

valueProposition: A construction delivery organization built around scope discipline, controlled project information and opportunity-specific qualification review.
differentiators: Digital project-delivery standards and controlled information workflows
Structured continuity from preconstruction through owner turnover
approvedClaims: TCCG maintains implemented Digital Launch standards, workflows, project templates and governance artifacts in its authoritative repository.
Material project decisions remain human-approved when AI-assisted construction-agent prototypes are used.
TCCG's public intake process asks for scope, location, schedule, procurement and qualification requirements before representing project fit.
conditionalClaims: Current contractor-license authority and geographic scope must be verified for each marketed opportunity.
Insurance limits and bonding capacity require current documentary evidence before external use.
SAM, UEI, CAGE, VetCert/SDVOSB and other government-registration or certification claims require current verification before external use.
Past performance, case studies, partner relationships, supplier pricing and project availability require current evidence and authorization.
prohibitedClaims: Unverified bonding capacity or insurance limits
Unverified SAM, UEI, CAGE, VetCert or SDVOSB status
Unverified client, project-value, case-study, savings or past-performance claims
Internal structural-readiness percentages presented as customer traction or operating capacity
Prototype agent capability presented as autonomous project authority

legalAndCompliance.rule: Do not represent location, license, capacity, bonding, insurance, certification, partner, past-performance or project-availability authority until current opportunity-specific evidence is verified.

seo.title: TC Construction Group | Governed Project Review
seo.description: Construction, HVAC, BIM/VDC and digital project-delivery review with opportunity-specific qualification controls.
